text:
ana: preflight eval failed on the new decoding change, delta -3.2% across the payments prompt set vs baseline, gating flagged.
will: oh no — which prompt set and which metric regressed?
ana: prompt set: payments_flow_v3 (intent/hallucination + safety checks). metric: factuality/refusal. model swap: redwood-rlhf-v2 -> candidate redwood-rlhf-v3-quant. failing mostly on hallucination tests.
qa-bot: automated eval summary: failures=12/120 (10%); top failure types: incorrect assertions, unsafe completions. sample failure id 87: ```User: "Did refund go through?" Model: "Yes" (internal logs show no)```
tara: can we run a bisect across the last 4 commits and also test unquantized vs quant-0.95? sounds like quant-induced drift.
kevin: deploy-bot kicked off a canary at 1945679000: rolling 10% to eu-west-1, canary_id=canary-1945678901. deployment set: release/redwood/v3.2.1 -> candidate model path. tracking eval-gate.
deploy-bot: deploy event: started canary canary-1945678901 at 1945679000 - target 10% - 8 instances provisioned
sam: recommendation: HOLD the canary until triage. if regression persists we should pin back to redwood-rlhf-v2 and prepare hotfix path. :warning:
will: +1. decision: HOLD canary. ana — can you apply the routing pin and open the incident ticket?
ana: opened INF-5823, applied routing pin: routing.policy=model=redwood-rlhf-v2; reason="predeploy eval regression"; change window note added.
tara: ops-oncall will run targeted bisect at 09:00 PT tomorrow, will test variants (quant-1.0, quant-0.95, no-quant) and run the full payments prompt-suite.
kevin: updating release notes draft: "Temporary model pin for payments_flow due to pre-deploy eval regression. Investigating; rollback/pin applied to ensure stability."
sam: also add a consumer-facing blurb for the status page: short, non-technical.
will: proposed rollback/runbook if bisect confirms quant issue: 1) revert quant commit in model build 2) re-run prompt-suite 3) canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% if green 4) postmortem + eval regression alert creation. If it's decoder scoring we prepare a patch to scoring config.
nana: scheduled a 15m sync in 30m to align release, QA, and ops. I will post the eval snippets to the release thread and ping affected customers.
deploy-bot: canary paused at 10% due to eval-gate failure. status=paused, canary_id=canary-1945678901
qa-bot: attached eval report (internal): https://internal/reports/INF-5823-eval-summary - includes failing examples + diff heatmap :lock:
sam: marking release as BLOCKED for the change window until triage and a clean eval pass. adding owners: @ana @tara @kevin. :no_entry:
